global_responsive_constraints.shell: Desktop expanded, tablet icon rail, mobile overlay.
global_responsive_constraints.board: Desktop horizontal kanban, tablet horizontal scroll, mobile card/list stack.
global_responsive_constraints.graphs: Desktop canvas plus detail, tablet bottom sheet, mobile tree or simplified graph.
global_responsive_constraints.approval: Desktop queue/evidence/decision split, tablet stacked, mobile fixed decision bar.
global_responsive_constraints.documents: Desktop tree plus content, tablet selector plus content, mobile list/detail swap.

rules.layout_assertion: Integrated shell with header logo, global search, offline indicator, sidebar categories, footer sync status, and active PM surface.
responsive_rules: Expanded shell sidebar and persistent header/footer.
Multi-panel screens use split views or grids.
Graph detail panels remain visible beside canvas.
keyboard_a11y: WCAG AA contrast and visible focus indicators.
Keyboard access for routes, tabs, filters, tables, cards, graph controls, and dialogs.

Escape closes modal, drawer, dropdown, and command palette through shared keyboard handling.

Tables become card lists and tabs may become accordions.
Drawers become full-screen overlays and graph-heavy screens offer tree fallback.
keyboard_a11y: WCAG AA contrast and visible focus indicators.
Keyboard access for routes, tabs, filters, tables, cards, graph controls, and dialogs.
Every state color has visible text label and aria-label where status is compact.
Error, offline, saving, and sync messages use aria-live polite unless destructive.
Escape closes modal, drawer, dropdown, and command palette through shared keyboard handling.
